e: note:'Mandatory exit for 100% of Persian Gulf crude. Minimum navigable width ~3 km. No alternative maritime route exists for laden VLCCs out of the Gulf. Largest single chokepoint in India\'s import book.'

e: note:'Two sequential chokepoints on the Russian Ural route. Bosphorus minimum width ~0.7 km; transit rights governed by the Montreux Convention (1936). Suez/Bab el-Mandeb subject to active Houthi disruption since late 2023.'

e: note:'Open ocean - no closure risk, no territorial waters, no transit authority. West African and American crude rounds the Cape. Adds ~10–12 days versus a Suez routing. Zero structural chokepoint dependency.'
